text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp is over before we know it, and Mejiro Ryan remains inexperienced in… certain areas.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Well… I had absolutely zero romantic encounters this summer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I did great in the watermelon splitting contest, and I helped carry the mikoshi shrine at the summer festival, but that was about it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hm, maybe it's for the best. With the Arima Kinen coming up, training has to be my top priority.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: This will be fine. When it comes to love, I'll need more confidence than in racing before I'll find it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Someday, when my heart's stronger, I'll be able to tell someone that I like them…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: That's the kind of love I'm aiming for.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
choice_data_list: That giggle kind of ruined the moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Geez, you don't gotta point that out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The bus is leaving soon for Tracen Academy, where Ryan's rivals await.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer, did you hear the news?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: They say this year's Arima Kinen will be Oguri's last race in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There comes a time when everything must end, even for a superstar racer like Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That means the next time out will be Ryan's last chance to race her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen is gonna be all about Oguri now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: She'll show up determined to win. If I can't beat her there, then my dream's as good as gone…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A colossal trial now awaits her at the end. We'll have to do something special to prepare for this winter.
